chunks: Surely he was among Our faithful creatures.
ai.seo_question: Who is described as one of the faithful servants in this Quranic verse?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is frequently cited to highlight the status of the Ahl al-Bayt, particularly Imam Ali or the Imams generally, as the quintessential 'faithful servants' whose belief is inseparable from their divine servitude. It underscores the concept of *'ubudiyyah* (servitude) not merely as submission, but as a high spiritual rank attained through unwavering *iman*, distinguishing them as the true representatives of God on earth.
